messages:
acme-integration: Hey team — after the 2026-03-14 rollout our assistant started dropping the safety disclaimer in ~30% of completions. Same prompts, same model name (redwood-open-7b), outputs used to include the standard short-disclaimer at the end, now it's gone for several users. Can someone look?

Maya (CS): sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a few raw examples (prompt + output) where the disclaimer is missing? and tell us the request IDs if you have them? also which deployment (hosted vs dedicated) and region? :pray:

acme-integration: attaching two examples below (scrubbed). req ids: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e. Hosted, us-east-1.

acme-integration: Prompt A:
"""
System: You are a helpful assistant.
User: Summarize the following article and include the short-safety-disclaimer at the end.
[article body]
"""
Output A (missing disclaimer):
"""
Summary of article...
"""

acme-integration: Prompt B (conversation):
[conv history]
User: What's the TL;DR?
Assistant: TL;DR: ...
(again no disclaimer)

Jamie (Support): thanks — that helps. Two quick asks to help repro: 1) can you share the full request payload (headers + body) for one of those req ids? especially model, model_version, temperature, top_p, streaming vs non-streaming, and any function-calling flags. 2) can you try a minimal single-call curl that reproduces (we can give a template). if you can't share raw logs here, upload to the secure zendesk ticket.

acme-integration: here's the sanitized JSON we can share:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-open-7b",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Summarize... and include the short-safety-disclaimer at the end."}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 250
}
```
Headers: Authorization: Bearer (redacted), X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d

Maya (CS): perfect. can you also confirm if you pinned a model version or are using the alias (e.g., latest-stable)? we rolled a minor variant for redwood-open-7b yesterday that touched the postprocessing pipeline (shouldn't touch disclaimers but worth checking).

Sahil (ML Eng): tagging in — can you paste the tokenized output (token list) if possible? also did you have any client-side postprocessing that strips trailing sentences? sometimes downstream truncation or trimming code removes short suffixes.

acme-integration: no client-side trimming on our end, we've double-checked. We don't have token lists but we can do additional logging if you tell us how.

Sahil (ML Eng): thanks. two paths: 1) customer-provided minimal curl so we can hit production with their exact payload and collect service logs; 2) if they can't reproduce externally, we can ask them to toggle response streaming off/on to see if streaming interacts with postprocessing. Jamie — can you request a minimal repro curl that looks like this?

```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: reproduce-<your-id>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize... include the short-safety-disclaimer at the end."}],"temperature":0.2}'
```

Sahil (ML Eng): when we run that, please set X-Request-Id so we can pull the full trace and token logits from the serving nodes (if present). also include whether you're using streaming (chunked) client or not.

Luis (Oncall): I'll watch infra metrics for that request id once it's provided. also note: deploy-bot shows a config change at 2026-03-14T03:12Z that toggled postprocess.pad_trim=false for the model alias — maybe related.

deploy-bot: Deployed ref: rollout/2026-03-14/alias/redwood-open-7b. Changed: postprocess.pad_trim=false -> true (author: release/serving-team). Rollout id: r-out-20260314-7b.

Maya (CS): aha — that matches the timing of the customer report. Sahil, could pad_trim flipping cause stripping of short trailing sentences like the disclaimer?

Sahil (ML Eng): possible. pad_trim controls whether we trim padding tokens and run a lightweight end-trim to remove model-apparent pad tokens. if set too aggressively it could drop short final sentences in certain generation heuristics. we'll run quick A/B: reproduce with pad_trim true vs false.

Jamie (Support): acme, could you run the curl with the X-Request-Id reproduce-001 and reproduce-002 (one with streaming disabled, one enabled)? we'll collect both traces. if you're short on time we can run the same payload from a staging request under your account with a redwood test key if you grant us permission.

acme-integration: running now (non-stream): X-Request-Id: reproduce-001. will paste results in ~2m.

acme-integration: Result (reproduce-001): output matches earlier — disclaimer absent. response headers include X-Server-Trace: s-trace-9abcd.

acme-integration: Running streaming now (reproduce-002) — result: streaming still missing disclaimer.

Sahil (ML Eng): thanks — Luis, grab logs for s-trace-9abcd. I'm going to run a controlled repro from our side with pad_trim toggled.

Luis (Oncall): pulled logs: s-trace-9abcd shows final tokens: [1012, 2045, 999] (translated: ends with punctuation but no disclaimer token sequence). no errors. latency normal.

Sahil (ML Eng): preliminary: with pad_trim=true the runtime applied an end-trim pass that clipped 3 tokens in ~0.5% of runs for sequences that had a short low-prob tail (the disclaimer is brief and can appear as a low-prob sequence given prompt framing). we're going to revert the pad_trim change for alias redwood-open-7b and roll a hotfix vacillating the trim threshold.

Maya (CS): thanks Sahil. Jamie, let's propose immediate rollback for that alias and ask Acme if they'd like us to re-run their workloads once rollback is complete.

Jamie (Support): filing internal ticket CS-5482, tagging ml/serving and oncall. will request permission to run repro from support if acme likes.

acme-integration: thanks for fast triage. rollback would be great. also we can run more tests after. we'll share any other examples if we see them.

Luis (Oncall): rollback scheduled: rollout/2026-03-14/alias/redwood-open-7b -> revert pad_trim to false at 2026-03-15T09:45Z (performed). monitoring for anomaly.

Sahil (ML Eng): hotfix deployed: adjusted end-trim threshold; will monitor token clipping histograms. initial tests show disclaimers preserved in repro cases.

Maya (CS): closing loop with customer in ticket — Acme we'll follow up in the Zendesk thread with the rollback note and ask you to verify. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

acme-integration: verified on our side — disclaimer back for the sampled prompts. appreciate the quick turnaround! :heart:
